1. Executive Summary & Consensus.purpose: Consolidated cohort overview across 19 technically selected candidates

2. Company Dossiers.purpose: Institutional one-page dossiers per candidate with 7 standardized sections
sectionOrder: SECTION 1: Fundamental Snapshot (100-150 words: Revenue Trajectory, Margins, PAT, Leverage, CFO, Working Capital, Valuation)
SECTION 2: Technical Snapshot (Strategy Signals, EMA20, EMA50, SMA200, RSI14, ATR%, 52W Range, Support/Resistance, Volume/Delivery)
SECTION 3: QGLP Deep-Dive (Quality, Growth, Longevity, Price — 4 separate qualitative/quantitative pillars, NO composite stock score)
SECTION 4: Recent Accumulation / Smart Money (VERIFIED_NAMED_ACCUMULATION / SUPPORTIVE_MARKET_ACTIVITY / NO_VERIFIED_RECENT_ACCUMULATION_EVIDENCE / DATA_INSUFFICIENT)
SECTION 5: Management Walk-the-Talk (DELIVERED / PARTIALLY_DELIVERED / PENDING / MISSED / NOT_VERIFIABLE)
SECTION 6: Evidence-Backed Risks & What to Watch Next
SECTION 7: Data Integrity & Provenance Footer (P0/P1 Available, Missing, Traceability Hash)

3. Smart Money Sentinel.purpose: Institutional ownership changes, bulk/block deal analysis, promoter pledge shifts

4. Technical & VPA Matrix.purpose: Multi-session technical parameters across 7 trading sessions

5. QGLP & Fundamental Quality.purpose: Rigorous fundamental metrics history and QGLP evaluation

6. 10-Point Checklist Audit.purpose: 10-Point master institutional checklist per WealthOS specification

7. Fact Provenance & Lineage.purpose: Strict audit trail of every fact: table, source URL/filing, provider, fetched timestamp

8. Data Gaps & Integrity.purpose: Transparent inventory of missing or insufficient items with precise resolution
